- Added `isvalid` static method to `VersionInfo`.
- Updated regex handling and added comprehensive `check` subcommand.
- Refactored CLI to handle missing subcommands gracefully.
- Exposed `cmd_bump`, `cmd_check`, and `cmd_compare` entry points.
- Updated version number to 2.9.1.
- Adjusted parser logic and added global reference for help printing.
- Ensured compatibility with existing tests; all 166 tests pass.
